title: Launch / loading
behavior: Temporary splash; environment loading and tracking health.

title: Main Menu
behavior: Wall-anchored menu, 1.4–1.8m viewer distance; hand poke or pinch, no head-locked overlay.

title: Choose Mode
behavior: Only private online play or solo practice at launch.

title: Create Private Room
behavior: Host room creation; no public matchmaking.

title: Join With Code
behavior: Six-character private room-code entry and join action.

title: Multiplayer Lobby / waiting
behavior: World-scale remote sibling avatars, room code, voice status and Ready states.

title: Multiplayer Lobby / all ready
behavior: 3-2-1 start host countdown, synchronized across clients.

title: Invite Friends / private code
behavior: Invite card is anchored to physical wall, accessible to host.

title: Sibling Selection
behavior: Life-size avatar, spatial wardrobe options, cosmetics only.

title: Outfit Details
behavior: Virtual wardrobe control, no gameplay ability difference.

title: XR Comfort Calibration
behavior: Physical 1.6 m test plate, pinch affordance and comfort choice.

title: Mom’s Opening Scene
behavior: Fully animated Mom in room; world-anchored subtitles, brief skip affordance.

title: Rules / One Survivor
behavior: Narrative warning card; one elimination per round; independent competition.

title: Solo Practice Room
behavior: Practice grab, place, sleep noise, no elimination.

title: Round 1 — Living Room
behavior: Spatial announcement in room, 3-sec countdown.

title: Round 1 — Active Gameplay
behavior: No fixed flat HUD; local taskboard, physical clock, bedroom wake cue.

title: Task — Return Mug
behavior: Object-local grab and placement rings, target exposed on surface.

title: Chore Board — Expanded
behavior: Physical task board enlarged by approaching it; shared and individual tasks.

title: Pet Alert — Cat
behavior: Localized cue near pet, no full-screen warning.

title: Pet Alert — Dog
behavior: Dog may chase squeaky toy, visual cue local to object.

title: Sibling Sabotage — Object Trap
behavior: Player physically rearranges props; no arbitrary prank button.

title: Prank Detected
behavior: Alert appears near rigged object; clear visible counterplay.

title: Noise Incident — Falling Pan
behavior: Spatial sound waves emerge from collision origin, replayable noise score.

title: Mom Stirring — Warning
behavior: Drowsy reaction + bedroom light, diegetic wake cue.

title: Mom Almost Awake
behavior: Strong bedroom environmental cue, no eye-locked overlay.

title: Mom Investigation
behavior: Mom physical entrance, active gameplay freezes safely, implicated culprit sourced from ledger.

title: Incident Evidence
behavior: Causal record presentation, not arbitrary score-based blame.

title: First Elimination
behavior: One competitor sent to bed, three remain; not a team win.

title: Spectator / Bedtime
behavior: Voice and harmless stickers, no collision, no task or sabotage actions.

title: Room Transition
behavior: Persistent Photon session; Fusion-authoritative scene sync.

title: Round 2 — Kitchen
behavior: Three players; 130 sec; server-authoritative start countdown.

title: Round 2 — Kitchen Gameplay
behavior: Taskboard, clock, local pet signs, no full-screen HUD.

title: Kitchen Hazard — Slipping Plates
behavior: Physics danger with grip feedback, visual rescue target.

title: Kitchen Pet & Sabotage
behavior: Rival lures cat with toy; causal blame when inevitable chain starts.

title: Quiet End — Mom Inspects Chores
behavior: Timer expiry or all shared chores complete; lowest contribution eliminated.

title: Second Elimination
behavior: One eliminated, two proceed to laundry final.

title: Final Round — Laundry
behavior: Two remaining siblings; 110 sec final round.

title: Final Round — Laundry Gameplay
behavior: Final round chores, countdown and distant mother cues.

title: Tie Break — Sudden Death
behavior: Only if same score and deterministic tiebreaks persist; 20-sec quick task.

title: Winner Reveal
behavior: Single survivor winner, no team win or currency rewards.

title: Family Scoreboard
behavior: Ranking by survival first; chores and attributed noise shown as stats.

title: Funny Awards
behavior: Noncompetitive humorous awards, no XP/currency/chests.

title: Chaos Replay
behavior: Game-state reconstruction, not actual camera footage, spectator safe.

title: Rematch / Same Party
behavior: Preserves voice and party, regenerates chores and hazards.

title: Pause / Personal Menu
behavior: Per-player world-anchored pause panel; online match continues for others.

title: Settings / Audio
behavior: SFX, Mom voice, voice chat options; voice chat never affects Mom noise.

title: VR Comfort Settings
behavior: Seated, snap turn, teleport, UI scale; all hand-accessible.

title: Hand Tracking Lost
behavior: Freeze grab safely; stop locomotion and ask for visible hands.

title: Multiplayer Reconnecting
behavior: No input to live physics until network state recovered.

title: Invalid Invite Code
behavior: Safe error recovery, join lobby untouched.

title: Practice Complete
behavior: Invites user to private multiplayer after safe interaction tutorial.

title: Voice Chat Permissions
behavior: Microphone is optional, mute default if denied. Clear per-user permission.

title: Leave Match Confirmation
behavior: Destructive exit confirms; spectators and host session handled explicitly.
